blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing GHSm token has no direct governance-controlled blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Broker/exchange burn and Celo-VM gas debiting are protocol-scoped, not governance holder-freeze controls. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is a governance surface but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The sole registered GHSm deployment is Celo 0xfaea5f3404bba20d3cc2f8c4b0a888f55a3c7313; the 2026-10-19 Pharos supply census assigns Celo 100% of circulation, so its controls are material against the 10% threshold. At Celo block 80489704 (2026-10-19T06:14:22Z; hash 0x42bb9d8457a53082b049e0fed7918070b4c9523bc772880c172d4337cf2c9ebf), the EIP-1967 implementation was 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e and the proxy admin and token owner() were the nonzero Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147. The proxy exposes owner-gated _setImplementation(address) and _setAndInitializeImplementation(address,bytes). Both proxy and StableTokenV2 runtime matched their verified source bytecode at the pinned block. The Timelock implementation was 0x3efad8f997f705675924470ec84677db68c5a2d0, its runtime matched the verified TimelockController, and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. At the same pinned block, timelock hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE 0xb09aa5aeb3702cfd50b6b62bc4532604938f21248a27a1d5ca736082b6819cc1, Governor 0x47036d78bb3169b4f5560dd77bf93f4412a59852) returned true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE 0xd8aa0f3194971a2a116679f7c2090f6939c8d4e01a2a8d7e41d55e5351469e63, address(0)) returned true (open execution). Governor.timelock() returned 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, closing a live governance scheduling and execution path rather than assuming a nonzero but unusable admin. This admin-upgradeable token is direct Possible even when the administrator is DAO governance and changes wait two days; the DAO-only exclusion applies to collateral, not the token itself. The current StableTokenV2 implementation has ordinary transfer/transferFrom and no blacklist, holder freeze, global transfer pause, seizure, allowlist or arbitrary-holder administrative burn. broker() returned 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators() 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and exchange() zero. Permissioned burn(uint256) burns msg.sender only, mint authority increases balances, and debitGasFees(address,uint256) is restricted to the zero-address VM rather than a privileged issuer holder, so these do not establish Yes. Neither variantOf nor mintAuthority.inheritedFrom declares a parent. The issuer reserve API observed 2026-10-19T06:16Z reports collateral.total_usd of $16,826,760.601825558 and asset weights summing to 100%. Against that complete collateral denominator, issuer stablecoins excluding sUSDS alone account for 58.2518%; counting the full 28.0181% sUSDS leg categorically through USDS gives 86.2698%. CELO, stETH and ETH/WETH are excluded from the numerator. This is the issuer collateral.assets denominator, not gross holdings plus separately reported LP/operational portfolios. This ancillary majority does not displace the direct Possible verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: At Celo block 78986505, GHSm's Broker/BiPoolManager USDm/GHSm ConstantSum exchange 0x3562f9d29eba092b857480a82b03375839c752346b9ebe93a57ab82410328187 uses GHS/USD feed 0x44d99a013a0dadbb4c06f9cc9397bfd3ac12b017, ChainlinkRelayerV1 0x1485c0e710ff9ef059834f42b312f10e7af823bd, and Chainlink proxy 0x2719b648db57c5601bd4cb2ea934dec6f4262cd8. getRates and medianRate agree on 85344620000000000000000/1e24; medianTimestamp is 1790887033. Effective report expiry and bucket reset are 360 seconds, minimumReports is 1, and spread is 1%. MedianDeltaBreaker is enabled at 4% with a 900-second reset cooldown; ValueDeltaBreaker is disabled. Stale reports invalidate ConstantSum quotes; BreakerBox halts rather than providing independent failover. Correction 2026-10-21 at Celo block 80683399: the singleton reporter is a runtime-matched immutable contract whose permissionless relay reads and validates Chainlink latestRoundData, not an arbitrary-price signer. Its proxy resolves to runtime-matched AccessControlledOffchainAggregator 0x86336eab11886a855af17e355164ea8e84fabb46 with ten registered transmitters and multi-signature report verification. The earlier single-source-or-laggy classification misread relay count as source-signing topology. Standard-external is restored under the orchestrator's source-misreading ruling; no independent-provider failover, human independence or sibling review renewal is claimed. Original pins and review dates are retained.

branchApplicability.rationale: GHSm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
